title: Unique Measuring Spoons
text: Unique Measuring Spoons. These are unique measuring spoons. They feel sturdy. The designs are beautiful. I don't think I would be comfortable using them with wet ingredients such as oil, but for dry ones such as sugar or spices, they are fine. I will also only wash them in the sink and as needed. I would be afraid that they would get damaged if washed too frequently.
